status: External finite-field first-jet exploration; no Lean or all-n theorem.
column_normalization: First divide F by A_t(a,b), then divide Fbar by epsilon^([a=2]+[b=2]); divide E_a by epsilon^[a=2].
normalized_limit: Prefactors become Z_a and Z_a*Z_b/L_ta; epsilon remains only in K and L.
legitimate_jet_test: Choose independent columns of M0 and a constant basis N of ker(M0); test [M0_piv,M1*N]. Stacking M0 and M1 is not used.
finite_field_lift: All constant denominators are nonzero modulo the prime. A nonzero determinant coefficient modulo the prime would imply the cleared rational determinant is not identically zero over the reals; its real leading order need not equal its finite-field leading order.

cases.constant_basis_invertibility: Kernel vectors restrict to the identity on free coordinates; adjoining the original pivot-column standard vectors is invertible.
cases.first_jet_matrix_definition: [M0[:,pivot_columns], M1*N]; N is the listed constant kernel basis of M0.

nonzero_first_jet_minor.order: Rows and columns in listed order; rows2j,2j+1 are components0,1 at pointj.

cases.scope: Full rank would certify a nonzero rational determinant for this finite n after denominator clearing. A non-full first jet does not exclude a higher-order determinant term.
